spine.claim: Julia is guarding a broken heart after her long relationship ends, and Damen guards himself behind his family wealth.
The two are forced together by a family inheritance conflict; each protects a self the other does not yet see.
Damen drops his armour and meets Julia where she is, standing in the rain outside her childhood home.
Trust costs both of them; neither can keep the old guard up.
Romance works only when each risks being seen before knowing the other will catch them.

signatureObjects.name: The white lattice trellis
signatureObjects.why: Damen climbs it to reach Julia in the rain; the narration names it as the moment he drops his armour
